description: Set up the Flutter toolchain and confirm a green baseline on branch feat/paso6-realtime before any change. The SDK is already cloned at ~/flutter_sdk (3.47.6, Dart 3.13.5); do NOT re-clone it.
steps: Export the toolchain: `export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true`.

Discard any autogenerated edits that pub get produces so the tree stays clean: `git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml` and discard any changes to .flutter-plugins-dependencies and plugin registrant files under linux/, macos/, windows/.

Run the exact CI commands to capture the baseline: `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` (expect 0 changed), `flutter analyze` (expect 'No issues found!'), `flutter test` (record the exact test count; expected 281), and `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check` (expect pass).
Record the observed baseline test count in this feature's findings.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter test` passes with the baseline count (expected 281)
`git status` is clean (no stray autogenerated files staged)
verification: flutter pub get && git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml
findings: Baseline verified on branch feat/paso6-realtime: `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` -> 105 files, 0 changed. `flutter analyze` -> No issues found!. `flutter test` -> 281 tests, all passed. `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check` -> up to date. NOTE: `flutter analyze` and `flutter pub get` auto-upgrade analysis_options.yaml (exclude build/platform dirs) and touch pubspec.lock; restore with `git checkout -- analysis_options.yaml pubspec.lock` to keep the tree clean. Dart 3.13.5, Flutter at ~/flutter_sdk.
